purpose: Create a new C-clef detector version after the frozen P4.7 independent holdout failure, without retuning P4.6 on that holdout.

principles: Do not use page IDs, source groups, teacher coordinates, or holdout-derived thresholds at inference.
Measure staff geometry in scale-normalized units.
Add controlled multi-scale staff detection before candidate extraction.
Keep candidate filtering source-independent and geometry-only.
Teacher truth may be opened only after candidate generation for development evaluation.
p0: Build a development-only robustness diagnostic over frozen 29 pages and synthetic scale variants.
Measure staff-detection survival, raw candidate recall, and filtered recall separately.
Identify failures caused by staff detection versus glyph localization versus post-filter rejection.
p1: Implement multi-scale staff detection with deterministic image pyramid and coordinate projection back to source pixels.
Deduplicate projected staffs and candidates in normalized staff-space geometry.
Preserve P4.5/P4.6 provenance boundaries and deterministic outputs.

nextSafeAction: Run P4.8 development robustness diagnostic on frozen development data only. Do not access P4.7 holdout artifacts during implementation or tuning.
